description: The illegitimate son of King Arthur, this young man and his father ended up facing off in a deadly duel. A mysterious sorcerer and a talented engineer managed to alter this disastrous fate with the power of the Grail. If Mordred would’ve been brought up as a legitimate prince, he could’ve been a lazy and idle boy. Being naturally skilled with the sword, he could have been less diligent with his training sessions, much to the displeasure of his instructor, the knight Perceval. Rather, he might have taken advantage of these hours in order to go seduce the court. Many women might fight in order to obtain his favor, but only a few gentlemen might’ve approached the charming prince, one of which being Lancelot. Enjoying parties, he could have spent a fortune in order to organize these grand banquets with his friends. The king might remain nevertheless blind to his beloved son’s escapades and he could’ve even gone all the way to offering him the legendary sword, Excalibur, for his coming of age. However, the prince couldn’t win unanimous support amongst the Knights of the Round Table. In fact, he might laugh at the famous quest for the fanciful goblet. While he might be an invincible warrior, could the kingdom be safe with a successor who is not very responsible?
fusion: Father! My friends! Let’s celebrate after the battle!
evolution: So handsome and strong... This is the invincible Prince Mordred!
